description_en: Queries the port forwarding rules created for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例下已创建的端口转发规则
name: DescribePort

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding protocol type to query. Valid values:

tcp: TCP.
udp: UDP
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的转发协议类型。取值：

tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: frontend_protocol

parameters.help_en: The forwarding port to query. Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的转发端口。取值范围：0~65535
parameters.name: frontend_port

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. For example, to query the first page of results, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则设置1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页包含的记录数量
parameters.name: page_size

NetworkRules.description_en: The configuration list of port forwarding rules
NetworkRules.description_zh: 端口转发规则配置列表

FrontendProtocol.description_en:
The forwarding protocol type. Valid values:
tcp: TCP.
udp: UDP
FrontendProtocol.description_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to which the forwarding rule belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 转发规则所属的DDoS高防实例的ID

IpMode.description_en:
The IP forwarding mode. Valid values:

v6tov4: The IP versions of the origin server and the client are the same. Requests from IPv4 clients are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers, and requests from IPv6 clients are forwarded to IPv6 origin servers.
fnat: Requests from IPv6 clients are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers
IpMode.description_zh:
IP转发模式。取值：

v6tov4：表示源站和客户端的IP版本一致，即IPv4地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站、IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv6地址源站。
fnat：表示IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站

IsAutoCreate.description_en:
Specifies whether the rule is automatically generated by Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium. Valid values:
true: The rule is automatically generated by Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium.
false: The rule is manually created
IsAutoCreate.description_zh:
该规则是否由DDoS高防自动生成。取值：
true：表示由DDoS高防自动生成。
false：表示由您手动创建

RealServers.description_en: The list of origin server IP addresses

items.description_en: The IP address of the origin server

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned port forwarding rules
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回的端口转发规则的数量
